title: Perfect little side table
text: Perfect little side table. I bought these to use as side tables on my front porch. They're perfect setting next to my white wooden rocking chairs.  Works out very nice for holding your sweet tea on a hot summer's day. Nice for when you have a pea shelling party, or just a nice little dinner on the front porch. My grandson who's 11 put them together for me. It took no time and I think he said the all the tools he needed to do the job were included. They're very sturdy and nice quality. You won't regret buying them. I love them.
